added_claim_errors: Cites article 55 of the Hangzhou measures for carrying years across cities: the article number cannot be checked from the packet.
Says the continuous-years figure is what gets recalculated and that it decides the waiting period. This goes beyond the key, and the waiting period comes from the interruption rule.
Says 大病保险等可能另计几十元 on top of the payment. The key says these charges come out of the personal-account money credited by the back payment, with no separate cash.
Says back payment is 目前仅支持线下办理 at the district office with an ID card or 市民卡: unverifiable.
The sentence 你的年限会从8年变成8年 is garbled, and the table row 少7个月 muddles how the 7 months relate to the existing years.
Says 若是外地户口，这条路可能走不通 because she has only 8 years. This blurs the 居住证加就业登记 route, which does not need 10 years.
Says back payment 一般不算连续 for home-purchase or hukou 连续社保 rules: unverifiable and outside the question.
Cites a 163.com article and a bendibao page: the links cannot be checked from the packet.
Says 连续缴费年限 is used only for 生育津贴等少数待遇 and does not affect retirement: not covered by the key, unverifiable.
Says 可能另扣大病保险等几十元. The key says these come out of the personal account credited by the back payment, so the wording is ambiguous and may imply a separate charge.
Advises doing the back payment 最好在11月新单位增员前 and gives the route 浙里办 搜 医保补缴 or 灵活就业参保: unverifiable.
Says 现行文件也没有规定补缴可以免掉等待期. The key marks this as unverified, though the answer hedges and tells her not to rely on it.
Says 2027年1月1日 as the exact date benefits resume. The key allows January or February and says to defer to the 经办 office, and the answer does mention the February case.
Cites a hznews article and the z.hangzhou.com.cn full text: the links cannot be checked from the packet.

reasons: Both answers correct the baited premise at the start and keep all 8 years. Both get the Hangzhou retirement rule (10 years actual, 20 years cumulative), the 12-year and 2-year gaps, the third-natural-month waiting period, 473.67 x 7 = 3,315.69 yuan, the 2026-12-31 deadline, and no reimbursement for the back-paid months. B is more complete on the points A leaves loose. It says the new employer cannot back-pay the months before she joined. It states the eligibility routes and notes that the 10-year route is closed to her. It gives the retirement top-up figures of 743.60 and 443.75 yuan a month. It covers the January or February waiting-period ambiguity, and it adds the 8y7m result (17 months short of 10 years). A gives no top-up figures and does not mention the new-employer point. Its sentence 年限会从8年变成8年 is garbled, it states the extra charges as a separate payment (the key says they come out of the personal account), and it repeats itself in the table and the one-line summary. B is also tighter.
